title: Agriculture & Farming
description: Subsidies, crop insurance, and modern equipment grants for farmers.

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: The Agriculture sector schemes aim to increase crop productivity, ensure fair prices, and provide financial security against natural calamities.

subheadings.title: General Eligibility
subheadings.content:
- Must be a registered farmer in the state database.
- Land records (Chitta/Adangal) must be up to date.
- Aadhaar linked bank account is mandatory.

subheadings.title: Application Process
subheadings.content:
- Visit the nearest e-Seva center or Agriculture Extension Center.
- Submit application with land documents and Aadhaar.
- Wait for field verification by the VAO.

title: Public Healthcare
description: Comprehensive health insurance and maternity assistance programs.

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: Ensuring universal health coverage and reducing out-of-pocket expenditure for life-saving treatments.

subheadings.title: Empaneled Hospitals
subheadings.content: Over 1000 government and private hospitals are empaneled under the state insurance scheme. Patients receive cashless complete care.

title: School & Higher Education
description: Scholarships, free laptops, and breakfast schemes for students.

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: Promoting enrollment and reducing dropout rates through direct financial and infrastructural support to students.

subheadings.title: Required Documents
subheadings.content:
- Aadhaar Card
- Previous Year Marksheet
- Income Certificate
- Community Certificate

title: Women Empowerment
description: Financial independence grants, marriage assistance, and SHG loans.

tableData.eligibility: All Women in Ordinary City Buses

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: Schemes designed to empower women financially and socially, ensuring equity and safe mobility.

subheadings.title: Self Help Groups (SHG)
subheadings.content: Subsidized interest rates and revolving funds are provided to registered SHGs for entrepreneurship.

title: Rural & Urban Housing
description: Free housing for the homeless and subsidies for home construction.

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: Aiming to provide a concrete roof over every family, eliminating hut dwellings across the state.

subheadings.title: Construction Timeline
subheadings.content: Funds are released in 4 stages: Basement, Lintel, Roof, and Completion. Geo-tagging is mandatory at each stage.

title: Youth Skill Development
description: Skill training programs, free coaching, and placement assistance.

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: Bridging the industry-academia gap by providing futuristic skill training to make youth employable globally.

subheadings.title: Industry Partners
subheadings.content: Partnered with major MNCs for curriculum design and direct placements upon program completion.

title: MSME & Industries
description: Subsidies, single-window clearances, and capital grants for startups.

subheadings.title: Overview
subheadings.content: Fostering entrepreneurship and industrial growth through capital subsidies and simplified regulations.

subheadings.title: Overview

title: Social Security Pensions

subheadings.title: Overview

title: Animal Husbandry

subheadings.title: Overview
